bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
expected=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:jitsi-450a4d6)
running=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)
test "$expected" = "$running" || { echo JITSI_LIVE_IMAGE_MISMATCH; exit 51; }
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 52
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.RestartCount}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = 0 || exit 53
test -z "$(docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 | grep '^JITSI_MEET_BASE_URL=' || :)" || exit 54
docker logs --since 10m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY bot_id=8872855519' || exit 55
echo JITSI_GAYBBS_LIVE_IMAGE_MATCH_PASS
echo JITSI_ENV_NO_OVERRIDE_PASS
echo JITSI_GAYBBS_READY_PASS
